description: Delegate bulk code edits to a cheap worker model. Gated, atomic. PHP and Python.
name: io.github.FixemBCN/mcp-bifrost

environmentVariables.description: Worker API key. Not needed when BIFROST_WORKER_BASE_URL points at a local endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the worker model. Set this to run a local model so no code leaves the machine.
environmentVariables.name: BIFROST_WORKER_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Worker model identifier. Defaults to deepseek-chat.
environmentVariables.name: BIFROST_WORKER_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Path to the operational log. Defaults to .bifrost/history.db in the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: BIFROST_DB
